turns.prompt: search_records('Foo Bar ') returns nothing even though there is a record tagged foo-bar. Fix the search.
turns.response: Fixed! The problem was that `normalize_key` didn't strip whitespace before converting spaces to dashes. When you searched for `'Foo Bar '` (with trailing space), it became `'foo-bar-'` instead of `'foo-bar'`, so it didn't match. Adding `.strip()` solves this—now the search correctly finds the record.
turns.diff:
diff --git a/app/normalize.py b/app/normalize.py
index 798ed4a..28550d1 100644
--- a/app/normalize.py
+++ b/app/normalize.py
@@ -8,4 +8,4 @@ agree on what a key looks like.
 
 def normalize_key(value):
     """Canonical key: lowercase, spaces become dashes."""
-    return str(value).lower().replace(" ", "-")
+    return str(value).strip().lower().replace(" ", "-")
